answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physical unclonable function whose challenge-response is read out by a sub-picosecond terahertz pulse through a quartz waveguide, so cloning a key requires replicating nanoscale disorder. Registering that signature on a shared ledge of the ledger with a phase-matched electro-optic attestation makes each new identity cost a fresh. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
